who.text: God, Paul, Jesus, Adam, Abraham and Israel.

where.text: Written from Greece during Paul's later ministry.

what.text: Paul sets out the gospel: all are sinners, God justifies by faith in Christ, and believers live transformed in Jew-Gentile unity. Genre: Epistle (letter).

before.text: Placed among Paul's letters after his missionary work.

stakes.text: Shows God's righteousness in justifying sinners and uniting Jews and Gentiles.
